newsitem.title: USA: Stimsonite sells auto insert business.
newsitem.headline: Stimsonite sells auto insert business.

text.p: Stimsonite Corp said Monday it has sold its automotive insert business to Leslie Metal Arts Co Inc (Lescoa).
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Stimsonite said the sale allows the company to focus its resources on manufacturing products for the highway safety market, particularly raised reflective pavement markers and optical film used on highway signs.

Included in the sale is an exclusive license agreement which allows Lescoa to use Stimsonite's electroforming technology for lighting for cars and bicycles. The technology is commonly used for manufacturing tail light lenses, Stimsonite said.
Under the terms of the agreement, Stimsonite will no longer manufacture the inserts but will provide technological and manufacturing support to Lescoa.
Stimsonite expects manufacturing to be fully operational at Lescoa by January 1997.
